requirements.requirement: The plan is written and identifies procedures relating to an emergency or significant business disruption.
requirements.source_quote: Each member must create and maintain a written business continuity plan identifying procedures relating to an emergency or significant business disruption.

requirements.requirement: The plan's procedures are reasonably designed to enable the firm to meet its existing obligations to customers.
requirements.source_quote: Such procedures must be reasonably designed to enable the member to meet its existing obligations to customers.

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses the firm's existing relationships with other broker-dealers and counter-parties.
requirements.source_quote: In addition, such procedures must address the member's existing relationships with other broker-dealers and counter-parties.

requirements.requirement: The plan can be produced promptly to FINRA staff on request.
requirements.source_quote: The business continuity plan must be made available promptly upon request to FINRA staff.

requirements.requirement: The plan is updated whenever there is a material change to the firm's operations, structure, business or location.
requirements.source_quote: Each member must update its plan in the event of any material change to the member's operations, structure, business or location.

requirements.requirement: An annual review of the plan is conducted to determine whether modifications are necessary.
requirements.source_quote: Each member must also conduct an annual review of its business continuity plan to determine whether any modifications are necessary

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses data back-up and recovery, both hard copy and electronic.
requirements.source_quote: (1) Data back-up and recovery (hard copy and electronic);

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses all mission critical systems within its scope.
requirements.source_quote: (2) All mission critical systems;

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses financial and operational assessments.
requirements.source_quote: (3) Financial and operational assessments;

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses alternate communications between customers and the firm.
requirements.source_quote: (4) Alternate communications between customers and the member;

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses alternate communications between the firm and its employees.
requirements.source_quote: (5) Alternate communications between the member and its employees;

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses an alternate physical location for employees.
requirements.source_quote: (6) Alternate physical location of employees;

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses the impact of critical business constituents, banks and counter-parties.
requirements.source_quote: (7) Critical business constituent, bank, and counter-party impact;

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses regulatory reporting.
requirements.source_quote: (8) Regulatory reporting;

requirements.requirement: The plan addresses communications with regulators.
requirements.source_quote: (9) Communications with regulators; and

requirements.requirement: The plan states how the firm will assure customers' prompt access to funds and securities if it cannot continue business.
requirements.source_quote: How the member will assure customers' prompt access to their funds and securities in the event that the member determines that it is unable to continue its business.

requirements.requirement: Where a listed category is not applicable, the plan documents the rationale for excluding it.
requirements.source_quote: The member's business continuity plan, however, must document the rationale for not including such category in its plan.

requirements.requirement: Where the firm relies on another entity for a listed category or a mission critical system, the plan addresses that relationship.
requirements.source_quote: If a member relies on another entity for any one of the above-listed categories or any mission critical system, the member's business continuity plan must address this relationship.

requirements.requirement: A named member of senior management, who is a registered principal, approves the plan and conducts the annual review.
requirements.source_quote: Members must designate a member of senior management to approve the plan and he or she shall be responsible for conducting the required annual review.

requirements.requirement: The firm discloses to customers how the plan addresses a future significant business disruption and how it will respond to events of varying scope.
requirements.source_quote: Each member must disclose to its customers how its business continuity plan addresses the possibility of a future significant business disruption

requirements.requirement: Two associated persons are designated as emergency contact persons and reported to FINRA, at least one being a member of senior management and a registered principal.
requirements.source_quote: The emergency contact information for the member includes designation of two associated persons as emergency contact persons.

requirements.requirement: Emergency contact information is updated promptly on any material change.
requirements.source_quote: Each member must promptly update its emergency contact information
